% Adapted from TeX Live 2025 tkz-euclide's Euler-line manual example.
\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.75]
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/A,6/0/B,.8/4/C}
  \tkzDefLine[euler](A,B,C)\tkzGetPoints{H}{N}
  % The manual uses tkzDefTriangleCenter[circum]; this equivalent subset
  % obtains the same circumcenter through the already-supported circle API.
  \tkzDefCircle[circum](A,B,C)\tkzGetPoint{O}
  \tkzDrawPolygon[teal](A,B,C)
  \tkzDrawPoints[red](A,B,C,H,N,O)
  \tkzDrawLine[add=2 and 2](H,N)
  \tkzLabelPoints(A,B,C,H,N,O)
  \tkzLabelPoints[above](C)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
